messages:
alert-bot: INCIDENT: High error spike detected (429/503) on inference endpoints /v1/embed and /v1/search-sim. 5m window: 429 rate 9.1%, 503 rate 2.8%. Top contributors: tenant-alpha (45% of errors), tenant-gamma (22%). Dashboard: https://console.redwood/ops/dashboards/embeddings-errors :rotating_light:

maria: ack, I'm on it. Opening the mitigation thread. Linking runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/traffic-shaping.

jay: thx. quick question — is this steady or bursty per-tenant?

alert-bot: metric snapshot: tenant-alpha shows sustained 700rps -> 429 increase when concurrent token load > 1.2M/s. 90th latency for /v1/search-sim jumped to 2.2s.

maria: tenant-alpha is doing heavy rerank which re-invokes embeddings per candidate. If we drop the rerank stage for them it should remove the hot-path. Suggest: 1) soft-rate-limit tenant-alpha 2) disable rerank feature flag for tenant-alpha 3) increase cache TTL for embeddings for 10m.

samir: agree. we can also temporarily route tenant-alpha to cheaper model (open-llama-7B) for non-critical calls. ops-bot can do a quick model-fallback if we toggle routing.

kevin: customer impact? do we have P0 customers in tenant-alpha? need to know before hard caps.

maria: pinging support — @kev, support says 3 paying customers are seeing degraded UX; none reported data loss. We'll prefer soft cap first.

jay: step plan: A) apply soft per-tenant rate shaping to 60r/s B) disable rerank for tenant-alpha C) enable cache TTL 10m for embeddings D) monitor 10m. If still bad, escalate to hard cap 30r/s or route to fallback model.

maria: executing A and B now. running trafficctl and ffctl.

maria: ```
# apply soft shaping
trafficctl set-rate --tenant tenant-alpha --rate 60/s --mode soft --duration 30m
# disable rerank for tenant-alpha
ffctl set --flag disable_rerank --tenant tenant-alpha --env production --value true
# bump embeddings cache
cachectl set --key embeddings:tenant-alpha --ttl 600
```

ops-bot: ACTION: trafficctl accepted. Shaping rule id=shp-8273 applied. ffctl confirmed flag disabled for tenant-alpha. cachectl updated.

samir: nice. I'll flip routing for non-critical endpoints to open-llama for tenant-alpha as a precaution. command:```
routectl set-fallback --tenant tenant-alpha --endpoint /v1/embed --model open-llama-7b --percentage 50
```

maria: done. Monitoring now. Dashboard short link: https://console.redwood/ops/short/embeds-err.

10m update — maria: errors down: 429 -> 3.2%, 503 -> 1.1% across cluster. tenant-alpha specifically 429 -> 4.8%. Latency 90th down to 1.1s.

jay: good improvement. keep on watch. let's not hard-cap yet. If metrics keep improving we can gradually remove shaping.

kevin: support update: customers notified via status page that we applied temporary traffic shaping to reduce errors; asked to report regressions. No escalations so far.

maria: quick note — we saw a small spike of 503 retries from the fallback model (open-llama) for longer sequences; lowered fallback percentage to 30%. ```
routectl set-fallback --tenant tenant-alpha --endpoint /v1/embed --percentage 30
```

ops-bot: METRICS: 5m after fallback tweak: tenant-alpha 429 3.9%, 503 0.9%.

samir: recommend a canary rollback plan: when errors <1% for 15m, revert flag and remove shaping in stages (first revert rerank flag, then reduce shaping to 80r/s, then remove).

maria: agreed. setting a monitor alert to notify this thread when conditions met.

maria: handoff to @jay for overnight monitoring — I'll be offline in 30m. Jay, you have control of trafficctl/ffctl if you need to tighten.

jay: taking handoff. noted runbook steps and contact list. I'll keep the thread updated every 30m. paging rotation: @oncall-next please monitor. :thumbsup:

kevin: thanks team. Postmortem owners? grab if you want, we should track root cause (inefficient rerank loop) and a product fix to avoid per-request candidate embeddings.

maria: assigning tentative postmortem to samir and product-eng.

ops-bot: NOTE: incident state set to mitigated by maria at 1834508550. Monitoring open.

jay: 30m check-in — metrics stable, reducing fallback to 10% and shaping to 80/s.``` 
routectl set-fallback --tenant tenant-alpha --percentage 10
trafficctl set-rate --tenant tenant-alpha --rate 80/s --mode soft --duration 20m
```

maria: thanks. Leaving final remark before offline: watch 429 trend on /v1/search-sim — if it flattens we can close in next hour.

alert-bot: next alert conditions suppressed for 1h while muted for this incident.

jay: handoff complete. last note: I've flagged tenant-gamma for a preemptive soft-shape 40/s for 15m due to correlated increase.

kevin: documented in ops notes. closing open support loop with customers.

maria: great work. I'll follow up with PMs on rerank optimization.

ops-bot: INCIDENT: closed by jay at 1834508870 (status: monitoring -> resolved after 2.5h).
